project_info.theme: Close-up fictional identity-card mockup held by a hand
project_info.creative_direction: visual study of portrait-card layout, laminate, holographic pattern, and typography
project_info.color_palette: warm ivory card, deep blue text, pale holographic rainbow, blonde hair, burgundy nail polish, and charcoal background

main_subject.type: fictional adult woman portrait printed on a clearly non-governmental mock card
main_subject.detail: adult woman with long straight blonde hair parted in the middle, fair skin with natural freckles across the nose and cheeks, neutral forward expression, hazel-green eyes, black top, and small silver studs
main_subject.card_design: fictional identity-card design with clearly invented institution name, placeholder fields, non-functional serial, and no real national emblem, government mark, or personal data

composition_elements.framing: top-down vertical close-up focused entirely on the mock card and thumb
composition_elements.subject_position: fictional portrait on the left side of the card, placeholder text fields on the right, thumb holding the lower-right corner
composition_elements.surface: glossy laminate with abstract holographic security patterns, guilloche lines, and controlled reflections
composition_elements.typography: legible fictional labels such as SAMPLE IDENTITY CARD and PLACEHOLDER, with no real names, dates, addresses, ID numbers, or government wording

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft even indoor light at approximately 5000K
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: slight controlled reflection on laminate and glossy deep-burgundy nail polish, clean forensic product-detail mood

technical_specs.render_style: macro product-detail camera with 90mm macro lens, top-down flat-lay perspective
technical_specs.finish: sharp card texture, realistic portrait print, restrained reflections, no readable real personal data

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a top-down vertical close-up photograph of a clearly fictional, non-governmental SAMPLE IDENTITY CARD held by a fair hand with a glossy deep-burgundy almond-shaped thumbnail. The card contains a fictional adult woman portrait: long straight blonde hair parted in the middle, fair skin with prominent natural freckles across the nose and cheeks, neutral expression, hazel-green eyes looking directly forward, black top, and small silver stud earrings. Place the portrait on the left and clearly invented placeholder fields on the right. Use legible labels such as SAMPLE IDENTITY CARD, PLACEHOLDER, and FICTIONAL DESIGN only; do not include real names, birth dates, addresses, ID numbers, national emblems, government wording, or functional document details. Add glossy laminate, abstract holographic security patterns, guilloche lines, soft even indoor light at approximately 5000K, slight controlled reflection, and clean forensic editorial product-detail styling. The card must be visibly fictional and unusable as identification.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, real government ID, real personal data, readable PII, real national emblem, real passport design, functional document, official logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hand, illegible placeholder text
